pageTitle: Klacks for Hospitality & Food Service in the United Arab Emirates | 48-Hour Week & Shift Schedules

hero.titleHtml: Early, late, night shifts — the 48-hour week scheduled safely.
hero.subtitle: Klacks schedules front of house, kitchen, and housekeeping under the labour law of the United Arab Emirates — with eight hours of normal working time plus a maximum of two overtime hours (Decree-Law 33/2021, Art. 17, 19), the 48-hour week, and the 50 percent premium for rest-day work (Art. 19, 28).
hero.screenshotAlt: Klacks timeline view for shift schedules in hospitality and food service

items.title: No statutory daily rest
items.text: UAE labour law knows no minimum daily rest between shifts — only a break rule: after no more than five hours of work, at least a one-hour break is due (Art. 18). Scheduling discipline is therefore entirely up to the business.

items.title: 24/7 shift operations within limits
items.text: Hotels in continuous operation may average up to 56 hours per week across shifts — capped at 144 hours over three weeks including overtime (Cabinet Resolution 1/2022, Art. 15). Averaging this correctly over weeks is hardly feasible by hand.

items.title: Night premium with an exception
items.text: The 50 percent premium for overtime between 10 p.m. and 4 a.m. expressly does not apply to shift workers (Art. 19(3)) — anyone who doesn't separate this cleanly in the schedule pays too much or too little.

solutions.title: How Klacks lightens the load for hospitality
solutions.subtitle: From the early shift to the night shift — it all works together.

items.title: 8+2 hours, 48-hour week
items.text: Klacks monitors the daily maximum of eight hours plus up to two overtime hours and the 48-hour week (Art. 17, 19) — every breach is flagged immediately.

items.title: Rest day & compensatory rest
items.text: One day off per week is mandatory (Art. 21). Anyone working on the rest day receives a compensatory rest day or a 50 percent premium (Art. 19(4), 28(2)) — Klacks tracks both cleanly.

items.title: Premiums separated correctly
items.text: Klacks calculates overtime, night, and rest-day premiums automatically — including the shift-worker exception for the night premium, configurable per rule set and with no manual rework.

items.title: Long stretches under control
items.text: At most two rest days in a row may be worked through (Art. 19(5)) — Klacks flags overlong work stretches before they end up in the schedule.

items.title: Klacksy schedules by voice
items.text: “Schedule the weekend, two servers are out sick” is enough — Klacksy recalculates everything.

items.title: Absences covered fast
items.text: If someone drops out, Klacks immediately shows who's qualified, available, and within break and maximum-working-time limits.
